sourceReadBeforeDesign.readme: S040: Cookie-less clients: Preserve mobile and API-client continuity without assuming browser slot-routing cookies exist.
sourceReadBeforeDesign.backlog: D-S040: authenticated cookie-less API/mobile drivers controlled from the web console; actual API clients move correctly without browser affinity assumptions and identity, state and budgets are preserved; no original prerequisite.
sourceReadBeforeDesign.card: A-S040: Remove browser cookies from an API-client trace; choose identity/routing rules that still work.
sourceReadBeforeDesign.portableContract: Standalone browser-openable worked exercise; explicit objective, preconditions, actions, synthetic trace, expected assertions, limits, exact banner and keyboard controls.
sourceReadBeforeDesign.packet: SC-S040 is the default source-strategy packet from the registered card. A-S040 is one independent S unit; B-S040 and original source-parent acceptance remain separate.

configuration.retention: In-memory, page lifetime only; reset retains full records and never replenishes the run budget.
configuration.unknownRule: Missing post-handoff observations and browser-only cookie traces cannot establish cookie-less continuity.
configuration.failureRule: Any known failed required check dominates unknowns while retaining those unknown checks.

sequence.executionClaim: Behavior specification mapped to focused Node assertions and actual browser checks; no Cucumber package or runner is claimed.

sequence.stage: Loadable stub and genuine assertion RED
sequence.failure: Loaded stub returned unknown where the behavioral assertion requires success; ERR_ASSERTION, not missing code, packages or tooling.
sequence.nonAutoDiscovered: Original source bytes use .snapshot; replay.cjs is outside test directories and is not named *.test.cjs.

sequence.stage: IaC applicability after RED, before implementation

sequence.behavior: Deterministic independent identity/routing/state/deadline checks, strict enum/data-property input guards, immutable results, guarded run/reset state, bounded retained history and text-only rendering.

sequence.scope: 15 model tests, including all 64 configurations, and five static page/manifest/CSP checks. Static checks do not substitute for a real browser.

earlierFailedAttempt.failure: After CSP correctly blocked form navigation, a Playwright locator waited for navigation and timed out. Direct DOM evaluation avoids that protocol wait without changing lesson behavior or relaxing CSP.
earlierFailedAttempt.classification: Preserved browser-protocol failure; not the behavioral RED and not a green run.

sequence.scope: Every owned file except the integrity inventory itself; raw stream lengths/digests, original RED source/assertion hashes, failed browser-attempt classification and successful closed-browser result.

tooling.lifecycleLimit: The published helper's documented unattended lifecycle limitation remains; no abandoned recovery prototype or unattended CI qualification is claimed.

proofPolicy.ordinaryVerification: Read-only to proof; capture flags are deliberate producer operations and historical files are never overwritten.
proofPolicy.rawBytes: Capture JSON retains exact stdout/stderr base64, SHA-256 and lengths; readable logs alone normalize line endings and trailing whitespace.
proofPolicy.redSnapshots: Non-auto-discovered .snapshot source bytes remain immutable and are checked against the pre-implementation provenance.
proofPolicy.captureEvolution: The capture utility added immutable attempt labels and fuller current-asset source hashes after the original RED; original captures and RED snapshots remain unchanged.
proofPolicy.newlinePolicy: Owned .gitattributes disables newline conversion so recorded byte hashes survive Windows checkout; cr-at-eol recognizes Windows line endings while retaining normal trailing-space/space-before-tab checks.

firstPublicationCheck.rawStreams: Gzip archives retain exact scoped git diff --cached --check stdout/stderr with raw/compressed byte lengths and SHA-256.
firstPublicationCheck.failure: The first publisher stopped before commit/tag/push: raw CRLF bytes were preserved by -text but initially interpreted as trailing whitespace.
firstPublicationCheck.correction: Added cr-at-eol recognition, without modifying original source/proof bytes or disabling normal whitespace checks.

userImpact.success: Both synthetic clients reach v2 without cookies, preserving their distinct subjects, all declared work fields and original deadlines.
userImpact.failure: Known identity, routing, state or budget interruption is explicit and retained.
userImpact.unknown: Unavailable mobile observations or browser-only cookie traces do not establish cookie-less continuity.
userImpact.reset: Current result becomes untested and defaults/focus return; prior records remain unchanged and the budget is not replenished.

nativeRemainder: B-S040 retains CORE, DATA, HOST and C032 gates plus actual qualified client/host evidence and explicit live-execution authorization.
